```{r}
library(Seurat)

library(clusterProfiler)
```

# using TF enrichment results to perform ORA
```{r}
branch_tfs_up <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_active_branch.csv")
branch_tfs_down <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_inactive_branch.csv")

lin1_tfs_up <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_active_lineage1.csv")
lin1_tfs_down <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_inactive_lineage1.csv")

lin3_tfs_up <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_active_lineage3.csv")
lin3_tfs_down <- read.csv("tf_enrichment/TFs_inactive_lineage3.csv")
```

# perform venn comparisons to see who shares what

```{r}
venn.diagram(x=list(branch_tfs_up$name, lin1_tfs_up$name, lin3_tfs_up$name),
    category.names = c("Branch", "Lineage1", "Lineage3"),
    height = 1000, width = 1000, 
    filename = "car_only/active_TFs_venn.png",
    resolution = 300,
    fill = c("mediumseagreen", "orange", "mediumvioletred"),
    col="white", alpha = 0.5, cex = 1.5, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "sans", cat.cex = 0.8, lwd = 3,
    cat.fontfamily = "sans")

venn.diagram(x=list(branch_tfs_down$name, lin1_tfs_down$name, lin3_tfs_down$name),
    category.names = c("Branch", "Lineage1", "Lineage3"),
    height = 1000, width = 1000, 
    filename = "car_only/inactive_TFs_venn.png",
    resolution = 300,
    fill = c("mediumseagreen", "orange", "mediumvioletred"),
    col="white", alpha = 0.5, cex = 1.5, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "sans", cat.cex = 0.8, lwd = 3,
    cat.fontfamily = "sans")
```

# get specific gene sets of interest
```{r}
branch_unique_down <- setdiff(
    branch_tfs_down$name,
    union(lin1_tfs_down$name, lin3_tfs_down$name)
)

lin1_unique_up <- setdiff(
    lin1_tfs_up$name,
    union(lin3_tfs_up$name, branch_tfs_up$name)
)

branch_lin1_both_up <- setdiff(intersect(branch_tfs_up$name, lin1_tfs_up$name), lin3_tfs_up$name)

lin3_unique_down <- setdiff(
    lin3_tfs_down$name,
    union(lin1_tfs_down$name, branch_tfs_down$name)
)

gene_lists <- list(
  branch_unique_down = branch_unique_down,
  branch_lin1_both_up = branch_lin1_both_up,
  lin3_unique_down = lin3_unique_down,
  lin1_unique_up = lin1_unique_up
)
```

```{r}
results <- lapply(names(gene_lists), function(name) {
  genes <- gene_lists[[name]]

  gene_conv <- bitr(
    genes,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )

  res <- enrichPathway(gene_conv$ENTREZID, readable = TRUE)
   res <- as.data.frame(res)
})

names(results) <- names(gene_lists)
```

```{r}
for (name in names(results)) {

  res <- results[[name]]

  top_res <- res %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)

  p <- ggplot(top_res,
              aes(x = -log10(p.adjust),
                  y = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)))) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey50") +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(name) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    ylab(NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "black")

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("car_only/", name, "_ORA.png"),
    plot = p,
    dpi = 300,
    height = 3,
    width = 8
  )
}
```
